crossRefs.note: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it…
Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that…
He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
translations.bsb: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. The man believed the word that Jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.
